# Provenance

On 2026-07-19, the `deploy-staging` job restored a stale cache entry because the cache key was based only on branch name and did not include the lockfile hash (Source 2, 14:07). The stale artifact caused staging to serve a build from the previous week, discovered during the deploy process (Source 2, 14:02). Investigation identified the root cause at the cache step, and adding the lockfile hash to the cache key resolved the issue (Source 2, 14:31). Approximately 40 minutes elapsed from discovery to fix (Source 2, 14:44), marking the first observed instance of this failure mode in the deployment pipeline (Source 2, 14:44).
